section: A. Architectural alternatives and the contracts they actually provide
title: Cancellation, reuse, and ownership contracts
requested_scope: Specify separately who owns work, who can cancel it, who can consume its result, and when cached work may be reused. Model two clients sharing a job. Look for cases where cancelling one request incorrectly kills another or permits an obsolete result to publish.
new_evidence_scope_and_limit: Pinned architecture precedent/source comparison and three runnable toy process topologies with failure, restart and collision controls. Boundary: Toy hash-and-sleep backend; not matched real Charon/Aeneas/Lean cost, upstream patch, or adopted design.
specific_remaining_delta: R47 shared one real offline Cargo build between two toy consumers: one cancellation preserved the other, last-owner cancellation stopped descendants, and a failed build fanned out then retried. Anneal request identity, cross-stage publication and independent LSP/MCP clients remain untested.
v12_evidence_scope_and_limit: Direct Lean processed -32800 cancellation and continued service; private Cargo process group with build-script child killed while peer survived, followed by successful retry. Boundary: Owner/refcount decisions are in a single Python harness, not Anneal/LSP/MCP; no Charon/Aeneas/Lake/Lean shared stage, durable registry or full target-tree transaction.

title: Multiple writers to one workspace
requested_scope: Race an editor, MCP agent, generator, and external filesystem tool. Compare exclusive document ownership, compare-and-swap edits, and explicit forks. Test conflict detection and lost-update prevention without assuming that all clients share one transport or obey one editor's version counter.
specific_remaining_delta: R26 ran two Lean-backed local candidate processes against one pointer: one CAS winner and one stale loser. Still test four writers and actual Anneal workspace ownership, fork and lost-update policy across tool stages/hosts.

requested_scope: Fuzz insertion/deletion around annotation boundaries and measure full versus incremental projection updates. Validate maps against regenerated ground truth after every edit. title: Rename and cross-file workspace edits
requested_scope: Rename Lean helpers used across annotations and external proof files while Rust symbols remain unchanged. Test multi-file preconditions, resource operations, and partial client support. Determine whether routing can preserve atomic intent or must reject a rename whose generated or ambiguous portions cannot be edited safely.

title: Versioned MCP contract and compatibility
requested_scope: Map the supported MCP revisions and client capabilities to workspace handles, long-running work, cancellation, progress, and result retrieval. Test capability negotiation and fallback. Separate protocol guarantees from implementation conventions and make workspace identity independent of accidental connection reuse.
new_evidence_scope_and_limit: One direct Lean stdio connection plus two logical local clients: unsaved source, versioned goal/diagnostics, CAS retry, dropped local event/poll, restart/rename and direct cancellation. Boundary: No actual MCP transport, editor extension, separate clients, diagnostic multiplexing or real Anneal bridge.
specific_remaining_delta: The stdlib 2026-07-28 wire model covers discovery, per-request metadata, version retry, task opt-in and legacy fallback; a second current-wire toy bridge carried an actual pinned Lean goal and stale source digest. No SDK/client interoperability, existing Lean adapter, authenticated task store or Anneal MCP implementation was exercised.

section: I. MCP state, agent workflows, and shared authority
title: Cancellation, backpressure, and reconnect over MCP
requested_scope: Interrupt long checks and large result streams over supported transports. Test slow clients, dropped responses, request cancellation, progress loss, and retrieval after reconnection. Determine which work survives and how its result expires without leaking workers or conflating transport failure with proof failure.
new_evidence_scope_and_limit: One direct Lean stdio connection plus two logical local clients: unsaved source, versioned goal/diagnostics, CAS retry, dropped local event/poll, restart/rename and direct cancellation. Boundary: No actual MCP transport, editor extension, separate clients, diagnostic multiplexing or real Anneal bridge.
specific_remaining_delta: The stdlib wire model covers polling, final result, cooperative task cancel and error classes; the Lean-backed composition shows cancel-before-start avoids a query and in-flight tasks/cancel forwards Lean $/cancelRequest with -32800, then suppresses the task result while a later goal query succeeds. Actual MCP client backpressure/subscriptions, durable reconnect, early compute interruption and Anneal task ownership remain untested.
v12_evidence_scope_and_limit: No MCP SDK found in scoped inventory; toy stdio bridge over actual Lean LSP exercised task handles, reconnect retrieval, expiry, cancellation, partial failure/recovery and capability fallback. Boundary: Protocol-shaped toy, not an existing MCP adapter or Anneal service; no SDK interoperability, revision negotiation or real editor client.
v13_evidence_scope_and_limit: Standard-library current-wire task envelope over pinned real Lean 4.30.0-rc2 LSP: sync fallback and task polling returned the same goal as fresh batch; stale source rejected; cancel-before-start avoided a query; during a slow in-flight Lean wait, tasks/cancel forwarded $/cancelRequest, observed -32800, and suppressed the eventual task result while a later goal query succeeded. Boundary: Still a local toy bridge and raw test client, not MCP SDK conformance or existing adapter; -32800 did not establish early elaboration interruption or resource savings, and there is no durable task store, independent client, subscriptions, Anneal workspace or authorization. | Standard-library stdio bridge exercised 2026-07-28 per-request version/capability metadata, server/discover, task-capable tools/call, tasks/get polling/final result, tasks/cancel, domain versus JSON-RPC errors, and distinct 2025-11-25 legacy fallback, with retained 62-entry transcript and negative controls. Boundary: Wire-shaped model only; no MCP SDK/client conformance, existing Lean adapter, actual Lean worker, Anneal task store, subscriptions or durable cross-client permissions.

requested_scope: Compare saved-only verification, snapshot materialization, and any supported compiler overlay mechanisms. Use identical intended bytes with unsaved annotations and ordinary Rust edits. new_evidence_scope_and_limit: Pinned Charon/Cargo workspace: 1/32/192 root closure, feature/build-script/include input perturbations and wrong-member partial LLBC after failed multi-library request. Boundary: Saved sources/fresh targets only; no overlay, warm-target proof, concurrent producers or full semantic normalization.

latest_evidence_scope_and_limit: Pinned Charon direct/Cargo two-process separate and shared destination trials, malformed shared JSON witnesses, controlled --format all FIFO stop after JSON, retry and stale-output failure. v5_evidence_scope_and_limit: Eight sequential private process-group stop/kill/retry trials across Cargo, Charon, Aeneas, Lake and Lean, including delayed Cargo/Charon/Lake child snapshots; a separate synthetic generation fence rejected eight late result digests. v6_evidence_scope_and_limit: Active FIFO output barriers stopped Charon and Aeneas with parseable/incomplete output sets; Lean run_tac blocked a Lake child after module A; process-group SIGKILL and private retry/fresh Lean oracle passed. A real old Aeneas CLI completed before an experiment-side late wrapper rejected generation 1 after generation 2 advanced. Boundary: Selected CLI phases/private roots and experiment-side authority, not Anneal scheduler; no general orphan proof, same-process API, every stage phase or transactional publication.

Boundary: Private filesystem copies are not unsaved editor/rustc overlay API; no same-process Charon reset, arbitrary build closure, complete target/config matrix, concurrent target sharing or Anneal scheduler/publication.

section: J. Cargo, rustc, and Charon input/execution boundaries
title: Shadow-workspace fidelity
requested_scope: Materialize workspaces containing path dependencies, `build.rs`, proc macros, `include_*`, environment inputs, and generated files. Compare emitted code and relevant compiler observations with the original location. Detect path-sensitive behavior before assuming a copied tree faithfully represents the same compilation subject.
specific_remaining_delta: R36 covered a bounded build.rs/proc-macro/include/env/path dependency closure in private copies; arbitrary build side effects, features/targets/nonlocal dependencies and a faithful production shadow-workspace policy remain unverified.
latest_evidence_scope_and_limit: Pinned Charon/Cargo warm target sentinel and absent-output controls; copied B shadow/private/shared-target path-sensitive build script produced 217/205 mixed subject; failed warm run retained old LLBC. Boundary: One selected --package --lib wrapper and path-sensitive fixture; no unsaved editor overlay, general target closure or same-process Charon reset.
v3_evidence_scope_and_limit: Pinned Charon Cargo lib/bin/test/feature/target/flag/reorder controls; four identical --test requests invoked three driver units and alternated final test/binary LLBC despite success; regular-file 4 KiB partial output after RLIMIT_FSIZE, last-good copy and retry; two private concurrent requests. Boundary: One small crate, no unsaved overlay, installed x86 target, complete compilation-unit key, same-process library, all kill phases, real Anneal publication or shared writable target.
v4_evidence_scope_and_limit: Ten offline private-target Cargo/Charon requests varied build.rs, proc macro, include_str, env, path dependency and source path; parsed LLBC/declaration projections and rejected a successful wrong binary unit. Boundary: One pinned Charon/Cargo tuple and saved copied workspace; no unsaved overlays, arbitrary input closure, same-process reset or Anneal scheduler.
v5_evidence_scope_and_limit: Eight sequential private process-group stop/kill/retry trials across Cargo, Charon, Aeneas, Lake and Lean, including delayed Cargo/Charon/Lake child snapshots; a separate synthetic generation fence rejected eight late result digests. Boundary: Independent CLI fixtures, launch-boundary stops for Aeneas/Lean, 80-ms delayed controls rather than phase barriers, no Anneal scheduler, escaped daemon or integrated pipeline.
v6_evidence_scope_and_limit: Active FIFO output barriers stopped Charon and Aeneas with parseable/incomplete output sets; Lean run_tac blocked a Lake child after module A; process-group SIGKILL and private retry/fresh Lean oracle passed. A real old Aeneas CLI completed before an experiment-side late wrapper rejected generation 1 after generation 2 advanced. Boundary: Selected CLI phases/private roots and experiment-side authority, not Anneal scheduler; no general orphan proof, same-process API, every stage phase or transactional publication.
v10_evidence_scope_and_limit: Pinned Cargo/Charon extracted ten private materialized workspace requests with build.rs, local proc macro, generated include!, include_str!, env!, path dependency and separate binary. Saved/clean copies matched relative source and unit-graph subject keys; input perturbations, stale-key rejection and wrong-unit rejection were observed with retained LLBC, normalized five/six-unit graphs and per-request private targets. Boundary: Private filesystem copies are not unsaved editor/rustc overlay API; no same-process Charon reset, arbitrary build closure, complete target/config matrix, concurrent target sharing or Anneal scheduler/publication.

title: Cargo skipping the Charon-producing invocation
requested_scope: Warm Cargo caches, vary wrappers and target selection, and request extraction repeatedly. Determine when Cargo can report success without producing fresh LLBC. section: J. Cargo, rustc, and Charon input/execution boundaries
title: Charon process isolation and reset feasibility
requested_scope: Compare fresh driver processes with any feasible reused library/worker boundary. Run subject A, subject B, then A again after errors and cancellation. Inspect process-global state and compiler lifetimes; reuse is justified only by isolation evidence, not because `charon_lib` can deserialize LLBC.
specific_remaining_delta: R36 used isolated Charon processes; same-process reset after error/cancel and a fresh-process equivalence oracle remain untested.
latest_evidence_scope_and_limit: Pinned Charon direct/Cargo two-process separate and shared destination trials, malformed shared JSON witnesses, controlled --format all FIFO stop after JSON, retry and stale-output failure. Boundary: At most two tiny crates; kill boundary is before regular Postcard artifact, not all extraction phases or an Anneal output transaction. | Pinned Charon/Cargo warm target sentinel and absent-output controls; copied B shadow/private/shared-target path-sensitive build script produced 217/205 mixed subject; failed warm run retained old LLBC. Boundary: One selected --package --lib wrapper and path-sensitive fixture; no unsaved editor overlay, general target closure or same-process Charon reset.
v3_evidence_scope_and_limit: Pinned Charon Cargo lib/bin/test/feature/target/flag/reorder controls; four identical --test requests invoked three driver units and alternated final test/binary LLBC despite success; regular-file 4 KiB partial output after RLIMIT_FSIZE, last-good copy and retry; two private concurrent requests. Boundary: One small crate, no unsaved overlay, installed x86 target, complete compilation-unit key, same-process library, all kill phases, real Anneal publication or shared writable target.
v4_evidence_scope_and_limit: Ten offline private-target Cargo/Charon requests varied build.rs, proc macro, include_str, env, path dependency and source path; parsed LLBC/declaration projections and rejected a successful wrong binary unit. Boundary: One pinned Charon/Cargo tuple and saved copied workspace; no unsaved overlays, arbitrary input closure, same-process reset or Anneal scheduler.
v5_evidence_scope_and_limit: Eight sequential private process-group stop/kill/retry trials across Cargo, Charon, Aeneas, Lake and Lean, including delayed Cargo/Charon/Lake child snapshots; a separate synthetic generation fence rejected eight late result digests. Boundary: Independent CLI fixtures, launch-boundary stops for Aeneas/Lean, 80-ms delayed controls rather than phase barriers, no Anneal scheduler, escaped daemon or integrated pipeline.
v6_evidence_scope_and_limit: Active FIFO output barriers stopped Charon and Aeneas with parseable/incomplete output sets; Lean run_tac blocked a Lake child after module A; process-group SIGKILL and private retry/fresh Lean oracle passed. title: Charon output transaction and completeness
requested_scope: Interrupt or fail extraction at multiple stages with a previous successful output present. new_evidence_scope_and_limit: Pinned Charon/Cargo workspace: 1/32/192 root closure, feature/build-script/include input perturbations and wrong-member partial LLBC after failed multi-library request. section: J. Cargo, rustc, and Charon input/execution boundaries
title: LLBC identity, normalization, and source metadata
requested_scope: Perturb paths, comments, declaration order, tool flags, and compiler revisions. Compare raw LLBC with proposed cache-key normalization. Construct cases where apparently incidental metadata affects annotation association or diagnostics; separate semantic translation reuse from freshness of source provenance.
new_evidence_scope_and_limit: Pinned Charon/Cargo workspace: 1/32/192 root closure, feature/build-script/include input perturbations and wrong-member partial LLBC after failed multi-library request. Boundary: Saved sources/fresh targets only; no overlay, warm-target proof, concurrent producers or full semantic normalization.
specific_remaining_delta: R42 isolated five source-unchanged same-path Charon LLBC hash changes to permutations of the 225-byte translated.short_names array; R43 fed all five into pinned one-shot Aeneas and obtained identical Lean bytes/declarations and successful fresh proof oracles. Arbitrary input/path/flag/revision variation, annotation/provenance safety, same-process behavior, general schema-aware normalization and actual Anneal key policy remain unresolved.
latest_evidence_scope_and_limit: Pinned Charon direct/Cargo two-process separate and shared destination trials, malformed shared JSON witnesses, controlled --format all FIFO stop after JSON, retry and stale-output failure. Boundary: At most two tiny crates; kill boundary is before regular Postcard artifact, not all extraction phases or an Anneal output transaction. | Pinned Charon/Cargo warm target sentinel and absent-output controls; copied B shadow/private/shared-target path-sensitive build script produced 217/205 mixed subject; failed warm run retained old LLBC. Boundary: One selected --package --lib wrapper and path-sensitive fixture; no unsaved editor overlay, general target closure or same-process Charon reset.
v3_evidence_scope_and_limit: Pinned Charon Cargo lib/bin/test/feature/target/flag/reorder controls; four identical --test requests invoked three driver units and alternated final test/binary LLBC despite success; regular-file 4 KiB partial output after RLIMIT_FSIZE, last-good copy and retry; two private concurrent requests. Boundary: One small crate, no unsaved overlay, installed x86 target, complete compilation-unit key, same-process library, all kill phases, real Anneal publication or shared writable target.
v4_evidence_scope_and_limit: Ten offline private-target Cargo/Charon requests varied build.rs, proc macro, include_str, env, path dependency and source path; parsed LLBC/declaration projections and rejected a successful wrong binary unit. Boundary: One pinned Charon/Cargo tuple and saved copied workspace; no unsaved overlays, arbitrary input closure, same-process reset or Anneal scheduler.
v5_evidence_scope_and_limit: Eight sequential private process-group stop/kill/retry trials across Cargo, Charon, Aeneas, Lake and Lean, including delayed Cargo/Charon/Lake child snapshots; a separate synthetic generation fence rejected eight late result digests. section: K. Aeneas translation boundaries and generated output
title: In-memory handoff versus serialized artifacts
requested_scope: Compare file-based LLBC/Lean exchange with available library or structured-stream boundaries. Measure serialization, copying, diagnostics, cancellation, and reproducibility costs. Identify where retaining bytes is valuable evidence and where mandatory files create needless latency or disk growth.
new_evidence_scope_and_limit: Pinned one-shot Aeneas CLI input/flag/schema matrix, complete file/declaration manifest, stale output and partial-sorry failure. Boundary: No same-process library call, registered external-model mutation, authenticated cross-layer mapping or second release.
specific_remaining_delta: The I086 one-shot file versus Python buffer-then-file Aeneas routes produced byte-identical Lean outputs and fresh proof acceptance; stdin Lean output had different OLean/provenance, and tiny transfer/RSS/corruption/cancel controls were recorded. Still test genuine same-process OCaml or structured-stream Aeneas handoff, large/concurrent workloads and Anneal cancellation/publication.
v3_evidence_scope_and_limit: Pinned Charon one-shot Rust fixture and Aeneas CLI; changed inc propagates to caller's Lean value, schema mismatch rejects, complete declaration/file inventory, unknown external template, missing/axiom/concrete user models, fresh Lean batch positive/wrong-claim checks. Boundary: No compiled Aeneas external registry mutation, same-process/in-memory API, authenticated ID-to-range map, full Rust semantic oracle or downstream service.
v4_evidence_scope_and_limit: Fresh one-shot Charon/Aeneas base, reorder, shrink and unsupported-pointer requests; inventoried emitted files/declaration ranges, checked fresh Lean consumers, stale reused destination and sorryAx after translation exit 1. Boundary: One-shot CLI, lexical source/range links and locally supplied external Lean model; no compiled external registry mutation, same-process OCaml API or authenticated producer map.
v9_evidence_scope_and_limit: Pinned tiny Charon LLBC passed to one-shot Aeneas by direct file and Python byte-buffer copy materialized back to file; identical three Lean outputs and fresh proof checks, tiny warm transfer/RSS samples, Lean --stdin module controls, corruption/mutation oracles and active FIFO cancellation/retry. Boundary: CLI still requires a file; no in-memory/structured OCaml Aeneas API, no large-workload speed claim, stdin OLean bytes/provenance differed, no Anneal handoff implementation.

section: L. Lake preparation and consumer configuration identity
title: Lean versus TOML package configuration
requested_scope: Compare equivalent package declarations with configuration computation, environment dependencies, and dynamic library loading. Identify mutable caches and hidden inputs introduced by executable configuration. Determine whether simplifying generated configuration materially reduces state without restricting necessary user packages.
new_evidence_scope_and_limit: Tiny two-package Lean/TOML clean and relocated prepared Lake fixture, no-build checks, isolated home/denied loopback, native facet and cache wrong-object/truncated-map controls. Boundary: No real Anneal archive, server query, complete plugin/native family, network syscall trace, concurrent restore or full integrity oracle.
specific_remaining_delta: Declare and test representative dynamic Lean/TOML environment inputs and package graph changes; R19 adversarial Lean run_cmd read an undeclared env value, which stayed stale in one built root, while TOML cells were static.
v3_evidence_scope_and_limit: Pinned Lake 4.30-rc2 source and tiny cache execution: actual 64-byte output-map interruption and invalid-JSON rejection/repair; artifact insertion permission failure; post-publication truncated OLean false hit and Lean crash; missing-object repair; two private read-only-cache consumers and one shared-writable overlap. Boundary: Source review covers some listed configuration/cache rows without direct perturbation; no power-loss durability, all object types, conflicting shared writers, archive, Mathlib or Anneal server.
v4_evidence_scope_and_limit: Three two-process same-key Lake cache-miss pairs, then real RLIMIT_FSIZE partial OLean/ILean/C object writes, no-build false-hit, direct import oracle and explicit delete/rebuild repair. Boundary: Tiny private package roots and one pinned Lake on APFS; no causally forced simultaneous artifact syscall, power loss, shared writable build tree or Anneal last-good recovery.
v5_evidence_scope_and_limit: Six pinned Lake source/path/option/consumer-manifest variants and four valid local OLean/ILean/C/setup cross-generation replacements; no-build/setup, setup-import batch, direct local batch/server and two valid plugin initializer markers distinguished consumed bytes. Boundary: One tiny pin/host; setup returned cache OLean rather than attesting replaced local file, direct watchdogs forced down after diagnostics, prior native plugin reused; no Anneal archive or power loss.
v6_evidence_scope_and_limit: Five clean pinned Lean/TOML configuration cells plus a deliberately adversarial environment-reading Lean run_cmd; no-build/setup/local batch/direct server under environment-only change, byte-preserving mtime shifts, valid wrong trace/setup and same-mtime source-byte edit with exact consumed OLean. section: L. Lake preparation and consumer configuration identity
title: Observable reuse versus accidental rebuilding
requested_scope: Record launched processes, writes, artifact reads, and setup outputs across repeated checks. Determine reliable reuse indicators even when command output is quiet. Validate actual parallelism controls rather than treating an unrecognized variable such as `LAKE_JOBS` as an enforced resource bound.
new_evidence_scope_and_limit: Tiny two-package Lean/TOML clean and relocated prepared Lake fixture, no-build checks, isolated home/denied loopback, native facet and cache wrong-object/truncated-map controls. Boundary: No real Anneal archive, server query, complete plugin/native family, network syscall trace, concurrent restore or full integrity oracle.
specific_remaining_delta: Lake action labels, net file deltas, .trace.nobuild after --no-build exit 3, and positive sampled Lean child processes distinguish selected builds from replays. No syscall-level read/transient-write trace, exhaustive process absence proof, prepared-scale parallelism validation or actual Anneal archive observation.
v3_evidence_scope_and_limit: Pinned Lake 4.30-rc2 source and tiny cache execution: actual 64-byte output-map interruption and invalid-JSON rejection/repair; artifact insertion permission failure; post-publication truncated OLean false hit and Lean crash; missing-object repair; two private read-only-cache consumers and one shared-writable overlap. Boundary: Source review covers some listed configuration/cache rows without direct perturbation; no power-loss durability, all object types, conflicting shared writers, archive, Mathlib or Anneal server.
v4_evidence_scope_and_limit: Three two-process same-key Lake cache-miss pairs, then real RLIMIT_FSIZE partial OLean/ILean/C object writes, no-build false-hit, direct import oracle and explicit delete/rebuild repair. Boundary: Tiny private package roots and one pinned Lake on APFS; no causally forced simultaneous artifact syscall, power loss, shared writable build tree or Anneal last-good recovery.
v5_evidence_scope_and_limit: Six pinned Lake source/path/option/consumer-manifest variants and four valid local OLean/ILean/C/setup cross-generation replacements; no-build/setup, setup-import batch, direct local batch/server and two valid plugin initializer markers distinguished consumed bytes. Boundary: One tiny pin/host; setup returned cache OLean rather than attesting replaced local file, direct watchdogs forced down after diagnostics, prior native plugin reused; no Anneal archive or power loss.
v6_evidence_scope_and_limit: Five clean pinned Lean/TOML configuration cells plus a deliberately adversarial environment-reading Lean run_cmd; no-build/setup/local batch/direct server under environment-only change, byte-preserving mtime shifts, valid wrong trace/setup and same-mtime source-byte edit with exact consumed OLean. Boundary: Tiny one-pin Lake graph; config-time source writer is adversarial and not declared Lake input, direct servers force-stopped after diagnostics, no Anneal archive/general key proof/power loss.
v7_evidence_scope_and_limit: Pinned Lake 4.30-rc2 two-package v1/v2 controls plus one valid mixed root: v1 source/OLean/ILean/proof, v2 plugin dylib/C/setup option. File-specific setup named exact OLean/plugin paths and option; fresh lake serve showed no goals, value 7 and v2 plugin initializer; hash inventory stayed unchanged; fresh batch also returned 7. Boundary: One tiny same-pin macOS graph; v2 C is present but not consumed, OLean read has value/hash oracle rather than syscall trace; no Anneal archive, general ABI compatibility, dynamic plugin replacement, read-only consumer or cross-version claim.
v14_evidence_scope_and_limit: Pinned offline Lake path-dependency matrix moved assigned name, graph index and consumer root against one physical producer; same producer configuration trace changed idx 1→2→1 while Dep replayed. Clean/replay/no-build/same-mtime rehash controls retained exit/action, net file deltas and bounded descendant-process samples; --no-build wrote .trace.nobuild on out-of-date exit 3. Follow-up direct duplicate-name requires failed before producer load in either order; through two wrapper packages, an explicit root manifest selected physical producer A or B independent of wrapper order in tested cells. Boundary: Tiny synthetic one-module producer and sequential consumers. Net file inventory cannot show reads/transient writes; ps polling can positively witness Lean child but not prove absence; no root fs_usage, actual prepared Anneal archive, later-than-4.30 Lake, read-only/concurrent consumer, server or product cache contract. Same-name control covers one direct duplicate and two wrapper-order shapes, not every version solver or nested graph.

requested_scope: Mix, omit, or truncate `.olean` components, `.ilean`, native artifacts, setup metadata, and plugins in isolated fixtures. Test loader rejection, diagnostic quality, and acceptance against a clean control. Establish which artifacts must be published together and which are optional for a specific operation.
new_evidence_scope_and_limit: Tiny two-package Lean/TOML clean and relocated prepared Lake fixture, no-build checks, isolated home/denied loopback, native facet and cache wrong-object/truncated-map controls. Boundary: No real Anneal archive, server query, complete plugin/native family, network syscall trace, concurrent restore or full integrity oracle.
specific_remaining_delta: R21 showed one same-pin valid Lake-discovered setup/OLean/native plugin mix; copied v2 C was not executed. Test wider combinations in actual Anneal generated consumer, including incompatible families.
latest_evidence_scope_and_limit: Pinned Lean/Lake direct batch/no-build and live plugin fixture: missing OLean/ILean/C/dylib by operation, dylib v1/v2 replacement, existing/new worker split and initializer mismatch crash. Boundary: Tiny explicit plugin; no general ABI equivalence, all search paths, generated Anneal archive or complete interactive operation inventory. | Real Lake artifact-cache writer killed during paused Dep elaboration, two consumers with one killed writer, repaired no-build/ordinary build, truncated output-map rejection and retry. Boundary: Kill precedes cache publication; no crash at mapping rename or same-package concurrent writer proof.
v3_evidence_scope_and_limit: Pinned Lake 4.30-rc2 source and tiny cache execution: actual 64-byte output-map interruption and invalid-JSON rejection/repair; artifact insertion permission failure; post-publication truncated OLean false hit and Lean crash; missing-object repair; two private read-only-cache consumers and one shared-writable overlap. Boundary: Source review covers some listed configuration/cache rows without direct perturbation; no power-loss durability, all object types, conflicting shared writers, archive, Mathlib or Anneal server.
v4_evidence_scope_and_limit: Three two-process same-key Lake cache-miss pairs, then real RLIMIT_FSIZE partial OLean/ILean/C object writes, no-build false-hit, direct import oracle and explicit delete/rebuild repair. Boundary: Tiny private package roots and one pinned Lake on APFS; no causally forced simultaneous artifact syscall, power loss, shared writable build tree or Anneal last-good recovery.
v5_evidence_scope_and_limit: Six pinned Lake source/path/option/consumer-manifest variants and four valid local OLean/ILean/C/setup cross-generation replacements; no-build/setup, setup-import batch, direct local batch/server and two valid plugin initializer markers distinguished consumed bytes. Boundary: One tiny pin/host; setup returned cache OLean rather than attesting replaced local file, direct watchdogs forced down after diagnostics, prior native plugin reused; no Anneal archive or power loss.
v6_evidence_scope_and_limit: Five clean pinned Lean/TOML configuration cells plus a deliberately adversarial environment-reading Lean run_cmd; no-build/setup/local batch/direct server under environment-only change, byte-preserving mtime shifts, valid wrong trace/setup and same-mtime source-byte edit with exact consumed OLean. Boundary: Tiny one-pin Lake graph; config-time source writer is adversarial and not declared Lake input, direct servers force-stopped after diagnostics, no Anneal archive/general key proof/power loss.
v7_evidence_scope_and_limit: Pinned Lake 4.30-rc2 two-package v1/v2 controls plus one valid mixed root: v1 source/OLean/ILean/proof, v2 plugin dylib/C/setup option. File-specific setup named exact OLean/plugin paths and option; fresh lake serve showed no goals, value 7 and v2 plugin initializer; hash inventory stayed unchanged; fresh batch also returned 7. Boundary: One tiny same-pin macOS graph; v2 C is present but not consumed, OLean read has value/hash oracle rather than syscall trace; no Anneal archive, general ABI compatibility, dynamic plugin replacement, read-only consumer or cross-version claim.

section: M. Cache correctness, packaging, and artifact publication
title: Relocation with the producer removed
requested_scope: Move the real environment and generated consumer to different depths, then make the original producer path inaccessible. Test manifests, setup, imports, native libraries, and diagnostics. Compare absolute-path retention with portable packaging; successful use while the old tree still exists is not a relocation test.
new_evidence_scope_and_limit: Tiny two-package Lean/TOML clean and relocated prepared Lake fixture, no-build checks, isolated home/denied loopback, native facet and cache wrong-object/truncated-map controls. Boundary: No real Anneal archive, server query, complete plugin/native family, network syscall trace, concurrent restore or full integrity oracle.
specific_remaining_delta: R21 copied a local producer/consumer pair but retained the producer. Relocate a producer-removed prepared Anneal archive with native/setup/server paths and retained workers.
v3_evidence_scope_and_limit: Pinned Lake 4.30-rc2 source and tiny cache execution: actual 64-byte output-map interruption and invalid-JSON rejection/repair; artifact insertion permission failure; post-publication truncated OLean false hit and Lean crash; missing-object repair; two private read-only-cache consumers and one shared-writable overlap. Boundary: Source review covers some listed configuration/cache rows without direct perturbation; no power-loss durability, all object types, conflicting shared writers, archive, Mathlib or Anneal server.
v4_evidence_scope_and_limit: Three two-process same-key Lake cache-miss pairs, then real RLIMIT_FSIZE partial OLean/ILean/C object writes, no-build false-hit, direct import oracle and explicit delete/rebuild repair. Boundary: Tiny private package roots and one pinned Lake on APFS; no causally forced simultaneous artifact syscall, power loss, shared writable build tree or Anneal last-good recovery.
v5_evidence_scope_and_limit: Six pinned Lake source/path/option/consumer-manifest variants and four valid local OLean/ILean/C/setup cross-generation replacements; no-build/setup, setup-import batch, direct local batch/server and two valid plugin initializer markers distinguished consumed bytes. Boundary: One tiny pin/host; setup returned cache OLean rather than attesting replaced local file, direct watchdogs forced down after diagnostics, prior native plugin reused; no Anneal archive or power loss.
v6_evidence_scope_and_limit: Five clean pinned Lean/TOML configuration cells plus a deliberately adversarial environment-reading Lean run_cmd; no-build/setup/local batch/direct server under environment-only change, byte-preserving mtime shifts, valid wrong trace/setup and same-mtime source-byte edit with exact consumed OLean. Boundary: Tiny one-pin Lake graph; config-time source writer is adversarial and not declared Lake input, direct servers force-stopped after diagnostics, no Anneal archive/general key proof/power loss.
v7_evidence_scope_and_limit: Pinned Lake 4.30-rc2 two-package v1/v2 controls plus one valid mixed root: v1 source/OLean/ILean/proof, v2 plugin dylib/C/setup option. File-specific setup named exact OLean/plugin paths and option; fresh lake serve showed no goals, value 7 and v2 plugin initializer; hash inventory stayed unchanged; fresh batch also returned 7. Boundary: One tiny same-pin macOS graph; v2 C is present but not consumed, OLean read has value/hash oracle rather than syscall trace; no Anneal archive, general ABI compatibility, dynamic plugin replacement, read-only consumer or cross-version claim.

section: M. Cache correctness, packaging, and artifact publication
title: Shared cache publication and interrupted restoration
requested_scope: Use isolated owned caches to race writers/restorers and interrupt downloads, extraction, and publication. Include missing, truncated, and wrong-identity artifacts. Require rejection or recovery without poisoning an already usable environment; distinguish cache-object atomicity from mutations of shared package directories.
new_evidence_scope_and_limit: Tiny two-package Lean/TOML clean and relocated prepared Lake fixture, no-build checks, isolated home/denied loopback, native facet and cache wrong-object/truncated-map controls. Boundary: No real Anneal archive, server query, complete plugin/native family, network syscall trace, concurrent restore or full integrity oracle.
specific_remaining_delta: Force simultaneous same-key writer/artifact/map interruption, recovery and power-loss durability; R19 valid metadata replacement had no interrupted write.
latest_evidence_scope_and_limit: Real Lake artifact-cache writer killed during paused Dep elaboration, two consumers with one killed writer, repaired no-build/ordinary build, truncated output-map rejection and retry. Boundary: Kill precedes cache publication; no crash at mapping rename or same-package concurrent writer proof.
v3_evidence_scope_and_limit: Pinned Lake 4.30-rc2 source and tiny cache execution: actual 64-byte output-map interruption and invalid-JSON rejection/repair; artifact insertion permission failure; post-publication truncated OLean false hit and Lean crash; missing-object repair; two private read-only-cache consumers and one shared-writable overlap. Boundary: Source review covers some listed configuration/cache rows without direct perturbation; no power-loss durability, all object types, conflicting shared writers, archive, Mathlib or Anneal server.
v4_evidence_scope_and_limit: Three two-process same-key Lake cache-miss pairs, then real RLIMIT_FSIZE partial OLean/ILean/C object writes, no-build false-hit, direct import oracle and explicit delete/rebuild repair. Boundary: Tiny private package roots and one pinned Lake on APFS; no causally forced simultaneous artifact syscall, power loss, shared writable build tree or Anneal last-good recovery.
v5_evidence_scope_and_limit: Six pinned Lake source/path/option/consumer-manifest variants and four valid local OLean/ILean/C/setup cross-generation replacements; no-build/setup, setup-import batch, direct local batch/server and two valid plugin initializer markers distinguished consumed bytes. Boundary: One tiny pin/host; setup returned cache OLean rather than attesting replaced local file, direct watchdogs forced down after diagnostics, prior native plugin reused; no Anneal archive or power loss.
v6_evidence_scope_and_limit: Five clean pinned Lean/TOML configuration cells plus a deliberately adversarial environment-reading Lean run_cmd; no-build/setup/local batch/direct server under environment-only change, byte-preserving mtime shifts, valid wrong trace/setup and same-mtime source-byte edit with exact consumed OLean. Boundary: Tiny one-pin Lake graph; config-time source writer is adversarial and not declared Lake input, direct servers force-stopped after diagnostics, no Anneal archive/general key proof/power loss.
v7_evidence_scope_and_limit: Pinned Lake 4.30-rc2 two-package v1/v2 controls plus one valid mixed root: v1 source/OLean/ILean/proof, v2 plugin dylib/C/setup option. File-specific setup named exact OLean/plugin paths and option; fresh lake serve showed no goals, value 7 and v2 plugin initializer; hash inventory stayed unchanged; fresh batch also returned 7. Boundary: One tiny same-pin macOS graph; v2 C is present but not consumed, OLean read has value/hash oracle rather than syscall trace; no Anneal archive, general ABI compatibility, dynamic plugin replacement, read-only consumer or cross-version claim.

title: Cancellation through every pipeline stage
requested_scope: Cancel during Cargo/rustc, Charon, Aeneas, Lake setup/build, Lean elaboration, and result publication. Observe descendants, pipes, locks, and temporary outputs. Require bounded cleanup or explicit escalation; successful termination of the parent is not evidence that all work stopped.
new_evidence_scope_and_limit: Direct filesystem/process fixture with nine SIGKILL phases, multi-file staging, late completion, locks/GC/restart and reconciliation. Boundary: Synthetic backend and tiny files; not actual Cargo/Charon/Aeneas/Lake/Lean process groups or crash-durable product state.
specific_remaining_delta: H09 observed processed direct Lean -32800 cancellation and private Cargo descendant kill/retry. Cancellation through editor/projection and every real Charon/Aeneas/Lake/Lean/Anneal stage, shared ownership, locks and product recovery remain.
latest_evidence_scope_and_limit: Pinned Charon direct/Cargo two-process separate and shared destination trials, malformed shared JSON witnesses, controlled --format all FIFO stop after JSON, retry and stale-output failure. Boundary: At most two tiny crates; kill boundary is before regular Postcard artifact, not all extraction phases or an Anneal output transaction.
v3_evidence_scope_and_limit: Pinned Charon Cargo lib/bin/test/feature/target/flag/reorder controls; four identical --test requests invoked three driver units and alternated final test/binary LLBC despite success; regular-file 4 KiB partial output after RLIMIT_FSIZE, last-good copy and retry; two private concurrent requests. Boundary: One small crate, no unsaved overlay, installed x86 target, complete compilation-unit key, same-process library, all kill phases, real Anneal publication or shared writable target.
v4_evidence_scope_and_limit: Ten offline private-target Cargo/Charon requests varied build.rs, proc macro, include_str, env, path dependency and source path; parsed LLBC/declaration projections and rejected a successful wrong binary unit. Boundary: One pinned Charon/Cargo tuple and saved copied workspace; no unsaved overlays, arbitrary input closure, same-process reset or Anneal scheduler.
v5_evidence_scope_and_limit: Eight sequential private process-group stop/kill/retry trials across Cargo, Charon, Aeneas, Lake and Lean, including delayed Cargo/Charon/Lake child snapshots; a separate synthetic generation fence rejected eight late result digests. Boundary: Independent CLI fixtures, launch-boundary stops for Aeneas/Lean, 80-ms delayed controls rather than phase barriers, no Anneal scheduler, escaped daemon or integrated pipeline.
v6_evidence_scope_and_limit: Active FIFO output barriers stopped Charon and Aeneas with parseable/incomplete output sets; Lean run_tac blocked a Lake child after module A; process-group SIGKILL and private retry/fresh Lean oracle passed. A real old Aeneas CLI completed before an experiment-side late wrapper rejected generation 1 after generation 2 advanced. Boundary: Selected CLI phases/private roots and experiment-side authority, not Anneal scheduler; no general orphan proof, same-process API, every stage phase or transactional publication.
v7_evidence_scope_and_limit: Seven active-gate CLI cases compared SIGINT/SIGTERM first signals with SIGKILL at Charon partial JSON/Postcard, Aeneas Types/Funs and Lake Lean run_tac barriers; process-group, pipe/lsof, selected advisory flock, same-directory retry and fresh Charon/Lean consumer outcomes recorded. A deliberately SIGINT-ignoring supervisor exercised bounded escalation. Boundary: Selected CLI phases and immediate process-group snapshots only; advisory flock probe does not exclude other locks/orphans, synthetic supervisor does not describe ordinary Aeneas SIGINT, no Anneal scheduler or transactional publication.
v9_evidence_scope_and_limit: Two separate pinned-Lean-backed local candidate processes crossed a barrier and raced a file-lock CAS: one immutable generation published, one stale loser. Four os._exit boundaries before/after candidate check, complete generation and CURRENT pointer replacement recovered via manifest/file hashes and fresh batch; mutation controls and reader-pinned old generation passed. Boundary: Local Python prototype with one theorem/import; no Anneal service, full proposition/axiom oracle, distributed transaction, actual worker restart, power loss, GC leases or cross-tool race.
v11_evidence_scope_and_limit: Four independent pinned direct Lean LSP process groups opened tiny goals. One malformed unsaved buffer produced a local diagnostic while peers stayed clean; a second group's request was cancelled on the wire and its process group SIGKILLed, then a fresh server reopened saved proof while two peers remained responsive. Experiment-side epoch/version/hash model rejected an old candidate; eight-worker cell was denied by admission. Boundary: Cancellation delivery was not acknowledged/processed before kill; stale fencing was a model, not a late Lean reply or Anneal scheduler; no admitted eight-worker, shared-import or generated-project fault run.
v12_evidence_scope_and_limit: Direct Lean processed -32800 cancellation and continued service; private Cargo process group with build-script child killed while peer survived, followed by successful retry. Boundary: Separate stages/owners; no editor-to-Anneal scheduler identity, shared in-flight job, Charon/Aeneas/Lake cancellation or product recovery.

section: N. Scheduling, cancellation, crash recovery, and failure states
title: Single-flight builds with several consumers
requested_scope: Let multiple proofs request the same dependency generation, then cancel or fail individual consumers. Compare shared in-flight jobs with redundant isolated builds. Test ownership, reference counts, retries, and fan-out of failure so one requester neither corrupts nor indefinitely blocks others.
new_evidence_scope_and_limit: Direct filesystem/process fixture with nine SIGKILL phases, multi-file staging, late completion, locks/GC/restart and reconciliation. Boundary: Synthetic backend and tiny files; not actual Cargo/Charon/Aeneas/Lake/Lean process groups or crash-durable product state.
specific_remaining_delta: R47 exercised two owners of one actual Cargo process plus one-cancel, both-cancel and failure/retry, but owner/refcount logic was a single Python harness. Actual Anneal single-flight cache/build fan-out and durable cancellation/recovery remain.
v12_evidence_scope_and_limit: Direct Lean processed -32800 cancellation and continued service; private Cargo process group with build-script child killed while peer survived, followed by successful retry. Boundary: Separate stages/owners; no editor-to-Anneal scheduler identity, shared in-flight job, Charon/Aeneas/Lake cancellation or product recovery. | One real offline Cargo build shared by two toy consumer records: first cancellation preserves surviving owner; last-owner SIGTERM stops Cargo/build-script/sleep; injected failure fans out; both failure/cancel retry successfully. Boundary: Owner/refcount decisions are in a single Python harness, not Anneal/LSP/MCP; no Charon/Aeneas/Lake/Lean shared stage, durable registry or full target-tree transaction.

section: N. Scheduling, cancellation, crash recovery, and failure states
title: Lock ordering and publication deadlocks
requested_scope: Combine environment preparation, generation publication, cache insertion, worker restart, and garbage collection. Inject pauses after lock acquisition and crashes while waiting. Identify ordering cycles and unbounded waits; compare coarse locks with a simpler ownership model before adding fine-grained coordination.
new_evidence_scope_and_limit: Direct filesystem/process fixture with nine SIGKILL phases, multi-file staging, late completion, locks/GC/restart and reconciliation. Boundary: Synthetic backend and tiny files; not actual Cargo/Charon/Aeneas/Lake/Lean process groups or crash-durable product state.
specific_remaining_delta: Build actual preparation/cache/publication/restart/GC lock-order graph under conflicting writers; R19 ran one operation at a time.
latest_evidence_scope_and_limit: Real Lake artifact-cache writer killed during paused Dep elaboration, two consumers with one killed writer, repaired no-build/ordinary build, truncated output-map rejection and retry. Boundary: Kill precedes cache publication; no crash at mapping rename or same-package concurrent writer proof.
v3_evidence_scope_and_limit: Pinned Lake 4.30-rc2 source and tiny cache execution: actual 64-byte output-map interruption and invalid-JSON rejection/repair; artifact insertion permission failure; post-publication truncated OLean false hit and Lean crash; missing-object repair; two private read-only-cache consumers and one shared-writable overlap. Boundary: Source review covers some listed configuration/cache rows without direct perturbation; no power-loss durability, all object types, conflicting shared writers, archive, Mathlib or Anneal server.
v4_evidence_scope_and_limit: Three two-process same-key Lake cache-miss pairs, then real RLIMIT_FSIZE partial OLean/ILean/C object writes, no-build false-hit, direct import oracle and explicit delete/rebuild repair. Boundary: Tiny private package roots and one pinned Lake on APFS; no causally forced simultaneous artifact syscall, power loss, shared writable build tree or Anneal last-good recovery.
v5_evidence_scope_and_limit: Six pinned Lake source/path/option/consumer-manifest variants and four valid local OLean/ILean/C/setup cross-generation replacements; no-build/setup, setup-import batch, direct local batch/server and two valid plugin initializer markers distinguished consumed bytes. Boundary: One tiny pin/host; setup returned cache OLean rather than attesting replaced local file, direct watchdogs forced down after diagnostics, prior native plugin reused; no Anneal archive or power loss.
v6_evidence_scope_and_limit: Five clean pinned Lean/TOML configuration cells plus a deliberately adversarial environment-reading Lean run_cmd; no-build/setup/local batch/direct server under environment-only change, byte-preserving mtime shifts, valid wrong trace/setup and same-mtime source-byte edit with exact consumed OLean. Boundary: Tiny one-pin Lake graph; config-time source writer is adversarial and not declared Lake input, direct servers force-stopped after diagnostics, no Anneal archive/general key proof/power loss.

title: Timeouts and resource exhaustion
requested_scope: Use bounded fixtures that exhaust time, memory, disk, file descriptors, or process slots. Distinguish proof failure from incomplete checking and infrastructure failure. Verify cleanup and recovery while preserving the previous usable generation; do not let empty diagnostics after termination imply success.
new_evidence_scope_and_limit: Direct filesystem/process fixture with nine SIGKILL phases, multi-file staging, late completion, locks/GC/restart and reconciliation. Boundary: Synthetic backend and tiny files; not actual Cargo/Charon/Aeneas/Lake/Lean process groups or crash-durable product state.

latest_evidence_scope_and_limit: Real Lake artifact-cache writer killed during paused Dep elaboration, two consumers with one killed writer, repaired no-build/ordinary build, truncated output-map rejection and retry. Boundary: Kill precedes cache publication; no crash at mapping rename or same-package concurrent writer proof.

Boundary: Source review covers some listed configuration/cache rows without direct perturbation; no power-loss durability, all object types, conflicting shared writers, archive, Mathlib or Anneal server.
v4_evidence_scope_and_limit: Three two-process same-key Lake cache-miss pairs, then real RLIMIT_FSIZE partial OLean/ILean/C object writes, no-build false-hit, direct import oracle and explicit delete/rebuild repair. Boundary: Tiny private package roots and one pinned Lake on APFS; no causally forced simultaneous artifact syscall, power loss, shared writable build tree or Anneal last-good recovery.
v5_evidence_scope_and_limit: Six pinned Lake source/path/option/consumer-manifest variants and four valid local OLean/ILean/C/setup cross-generation replacements; no-build/setup, setup-import batch, direct local batch/server and two valid plugin initializer markers distinguished consumed bytes. v6_evidence_scope_and_limit: Five clean pinned Lean/TOML configuration cells plus a deliberately adversarial environment-reading Lean run_cmd; no-build/setup/local batch/direct server under environment-only change, byte-preserving mtime shifts, valid wrong trace/setup and same-mtime source-byte edit with exact consumed OLean. Boundary: Tiny one-pin Lake graph; config-time source writer is adversarial and not declared Lake input, direct servers force-stopped after diagnostics, no Anneal archive/general key proof/power loss.

section: N. Scheduling, cancellation, crash recovery, and failure states
title: Restart reconstruction under forced failures
requested_scope: Kill the worker, watchdog, Anneal process, and build subprocess separately at recorded states. Reconstruct from authoritative inputs without inherited memory. Compare results to fresh checks and distinguish a restartable partial workspace from a generation whose publication never completed.
new_evidence_scope_and_limit: Direct filesystem/process fixture with nine SIGKILL phases, multi-file staging, late completion, locks/GC/restart and reconciliation. Boundary: Synthetic backend and tiny files; not actual Cargo/Charon/Aeneas/Lake/Lean process groups or crash-durable product state.
specific_remaining_delta: R38 reconstructed one saved tiny proof in a fresh Lean server after a peer process-group kill; stale rejection was an experiment-side epoch/version/hash model. Still force actual Anneal and build-process restarts and reconcile authoritative imported generations and durable outputs.
v9_evidence_scope_and_limit: Two separate pinned-Lean-backed local candidate processes crossed a barrier and raced a file-lock CAS: one immutable generation published, one stale loser. Four os._exit boundaries before/after candidate check, complete generation and CURRENT pointer replacement recovered via manifest/file hashes and fresh batch; mutation controls and reader-pinned old generation passed. Boundary: Local Python prototype with one theorem/import; no Anneal service, full proposition/axiom oracle, distributed transaction, actual worker restart, power loss, GC leases or cross-tool race.
v11_evidence_scope_and_limit: Four independent pinned direct Lean LSP process groups opened tiny goals. One malformed unsaved buffer produced a local diagnostic while peers stayed clean; a second group's request was cancelled on the wire and its process group SIGKILLed, then a fresh server reopened saved proof while two peers remained responsive. Experiment-side epoch/version/hash model rejected an old candidate; eight-worker cell was denied by admission. Boundary: Cancellation delivery was not acknowledged/processed before kill; stale fencing was a model, not a late Lean reply or Anneal scheduler; no admitted eight-worker, shared-import or generated-project fault run.

title: Per-consumer disk bill of materials
requested_scope: Attribute logical bytes, allocated blocks, inode counts, bytes written, and peak temporary space to Rust products, LLBC, generated Lean, local `.lake` state, dependencies, caches, and logs. Include writes outside the workspace. Identify every term that scales with workers rather than shared inputs.
new_evidence_scope_and_limit: Guarded two-Lake-consumer cold/warm run and two-server four-edit sentinel, sampled RSS/phys_footprint/disk with clean shutdown. Boundary: Tiny fixtures, no Anneal generated project, Mathlib, high-worker sweep, long soak, PSS or peak-between-polls proof.
specific_remaining_delta: R34 classified each tiny direct Lean worker byte/inode and R40 compared APFS/overlayfs copy/clone/hardlink counters for a 2.15-MB fixture. Full Rust, LLBC, generated Lean, Lake cache, archive, outside-workspace writes, temporary peaks and exclusive overlayfs physical bytes in an Anneal integration test remain unmeasured.
v3_evidence_scope_and_limit: Direct Lean 4.30-rc2 single-server 1/2/4 tiny file-worker guarded sweep, 25 exact-goal/diagnostic sentinels, 3 edits per cell, tree RSS/footprint, scratch bytes, latency and cleanup transcript. Boundary: 7.87-second tiny import graph; sampled summed RSS is not unique physical memory; no Mathlib-sized jobs, several servers, sustained leak result, full Anneal/MCP topology or cross-workspace conflicts.
v4_evidence_scope_and_limit: Direct pinned Lean server handled 24 edits, four close/reopens, restarts, wrong-import sentinel, rich info reference dereference/release and client timeout; sampled processes, RSS and footprint. Boundary: Tiny direct Lean 15-second run; no Anneal broker, Mathlib scale, hours-long leak inference, unique tree memory or proof of cancellation.
v10_evidence_scope_and_limit: Direct pinned Lean tiny proof generated in one/two cold byte-copy and warm shared-symlink worker layouts, plus hardlink and APFS cp -c clone controls. Every path was classified by role, regular payload, st_blocks, device/inode/link identity and SHA; each cold worker added five dependency files/6,189 payload bytes, warm workers added zero dependency payload. Boundary: Representative tiny Lean-only fixture; not real Anneal/Mathlib or full Rust→LLBC→Lean/Lake bill, peak writes, unique physical APFS extent accounting, or safe concurrent shared mutation.
v11_evidence_scope_and_limit: One tiny 11-file/2.15-MB fixture compared APFS copy/clone/hardlink/mutation counters with cached Ubuntu 24.04 Docker overlayfs ordinary copy, successful reflink, hardlink and clone mutation. Per-file logical/st_blocks/inode, APFS volume-free, GNU du/df and Docker SizeRw counters diverged; base bytes stayed unchanged. Boundary: No exclusive overlayfs physical-extent byte accounting, native ext4/XFS/Windows/network target, large concurrent Lean jobs, cache GC or Anneal archive layout; Docker linux/amd64 is emulated on arm64.

section: O. Disk amplification, memory, throughput, and latency
title: Safe concurrency scaling sweep
requested_scope: Increase independent consumers and active proof documents under explicit host limits, with cold and warm environments. Measure correctness, throughput, tail latency, CPU, memory, and disk before further increases. Test the intended high-worker workload without assuming that two successful consumers extrapolate or deliberately exhausting an uncontrolled host.
new_evidence_scope_and_limit: Guarded two-Lake-consumer cold/warm run and two-server four-edit sentinel, sampled RSS/phys_footprint/disk with clean shutdown. Boundary: Tiny fixtures, no Anneal generated project, Mathlib, high-worker sweep, long soak, PSS or peak-between-polls proof.
specific_remaining_delta: R34 distinguished copy/symlink/hardlink/APFS-clone accounting, and R35 admitted 1/2/4/8 tiny direct Lean workers; realistic import, CPU/throughput/latency, peak physical memory and safe shared mutation across server/Lake topologies remain unmeasured.
v3_evidence_scope_and_limit: Direct Lean 4.30-rc2 single-server 1/2/4 tiny file-worker guarded sweep, 25 exact-goal/diagnostic sentinels, 3 edits per cell, tree RSS/footprint, scratch bytes, latency and cleanup transcript. Boundary: 7.87-second tiny import graph; sampled summed RSS is not unique physical memory; no Mathlib-sized jobs, several servers, sustained leak result, full Anneal/MCP topology or cross-workspace conflicts.
v4_evidence_scope_and_limit: Direct pinned Lean server handled 24 edits, four close/reopens, restarts, wrong-import sentinel, rich info reference dereference/release and client timeout; sampled processes, RSS and footprint. Boundary: Tiny direct Lean 15-second run; no Anneal broker, Mathlib scale, hours-long leak inference, unique tree memory or proof of cancellation.
v10_evidence_scope_and_limit: Direct pinned Lean tiny proof generated in one/two cold byte-copy and warm shared-symlink worker layouts, plus hardlink and APFS cp -c clone controls. Every path was classified by role, regular payload, st_blocks, device/inode/link identity and SHA; each cold worker added five dependency files/6,189 payload bytes, warm workers added zero dependency payload. Boundary: Representative tiny Lean-only fixture; not real Anneal/Mathlib or full Rust→LLBC→Lean/Lake bill, peak writes, unique physical APFS extent accounting, or safe concurrent shared mutation. | Direct pinned Lean LSP pools with 1/2/4/8 concurrent imported tiny proof workers, serial cold local dependency builds versus warm prebuilt symlinks, open/edit/goal fanout, preflight 4.5 GiB admission, macOS per-process/group footprint/RSS samples, complete path/inode disk ledgers and owned worker cleanup. All 30 goal/edit cycles and clean shutdowns passed. Boundary: Two memory samples and one run per cell; no hard transient peak, sustained leak/CPU study, actual Anneal scratch service, MCP daemon, Mathlib-sized import or realistic CI capacity.

title: Nested parallelism actually enforced
requested_scope: Sweep outer job count and supported inner controls for Cargo/rustc, Aeneas, Lake, and Lean. Observe real threads/processes and peak resource use. Determine where one global budget can be enforced and where independently reasonable defaults cause oversubscription or misleading benchmarks.
new_evidence_scope_and_limit: Guarded two-Lake-consumer cold/warm run and two-server four-edit sentinel, sampled RSS/phys_footprint/disk with clean shutdown. Boundary: Tiny fixtures, no Anneal generated project, Mathlib, high-worker sweep, long soak, PSS or peak-between-polls proof.
specific_remaining_delta: R46 combined two tiny Charon→Aeneas→batch Lean workflows; R48 added one complete chain through cached Lake and live server with 2,590,336-KiB sampled RSS. Its two-worker cell was skipped. Anneal scheduler, enforced representative nested budget and hard peak/capacity remain.
v4_evidence_scope_and_limit: Direct pinned Lean server handled 24 edits, four close/reopens, restarts, wrong-import sentinel, rich info reference dereference/release and client timeout; sampled processes, RSS and footprint. Boundary: Tiny direct Lean 15-second run; no Anneal broker, Mathlib scale, hours-long leak inference, unique tree memory or proof of cancellation.
v11_evidence_scope_and_limit: One tiny 11-file/2.15-MB fixture compared APFS copy/clone/hardlink/mutation counters with cached Ubuntu 24.04 Docker overlayfs ordinary copy, successful reflink, hardlink and clone mutation. Per-file logical/st_blocks/inode, APFS volume-free, GNU du/df and Docker SizeRw counters diverged; base bytes stayed unchanged. Boundary: No exclusive overlayfs physical-extent byte accounting, native ext4/XFS/Windows/network target, large concurrent Lean jobs, cache GC or Anneal archive layout; Docker linux/amd64 is emulated on arm64. | Pinned tiny Charon/Cargo and direct Lean LSP ran separate outer 1/2/4 by inner 1/2 matrices (12 cells), retaining Cargo unit logs/LLBC and Lean goal replies, process/thread/RSS/CPU and selected footprint samples under resource admission. All cells completed; warm Charon no-op rewrote LLBC hashes; all process trees cleaned. Boundary: Separate tiny component ramps, not a combined Rust→Charon→Aeneas→Lake→Lean Anneal scheduler, realistic workload or physical peak/capacity proof; some short-lived Cargo PIDs escaped footprint sampling.
v12_evidence_scope_and_limit: Two private Rust→Charon→Aeneas→batch Lean workflows serial, parallel and one-Lean-slot; stage exits, selected proof/axiom oracle, output hashes and sampled RSS/footprint guards. Boundary: Tiny cached-dependency fixture; four workers skipped; no Lake/server/Anneal scheduler or hard unsampled peak. | One tiny Rust→Charon→Aeneas→direct Lean→Lake build→Lake-launched server goal→fresh batch chain completed with selected proof/axiom oracle and sampled process resources. Boundary: Two-worker cell skipped by memory admission after one-worker 2,590,336-KiB sampled RSS peak; no Anneal scheduler, editor switch, hard physical peak or representative concurrent workload.

title: Sustained edit/query soak
requested_scope: Run long sessions with proof edits, model changes, opened/closed files, scratch attempts, and worker restarts. Track retained environments, generations, handles, and processes. Distinguish bounded warm caches from monotonic leaks and find the conditions under which recycling workers is useful or necessary.
new_evidence_scope_and_limit: Guarded two-Lake-consumer cold/warm run and two-server four-edit sentinel, sampled RSS/phys_footprint/disk with clean shutdown. Boundary: Tiny fixtures, no Anneal generated project, Mathlib, high-worker sweep, long soak, PSS or peak-between-polls proof.
specific_remaining_delta: R39 extended a tiny direct Lean proof soak to 5.6 minutes across two orderly restarts, 63 edits/goals and 36 sampled footprint/tree/disk ledgers; sampled footprint plateaued after first elaboration. Hours-long realistic-import retention, cancellation/crash lifecycle, hard peaks and leak classification in an Anneal daemon remain unmeasured.
v3_evidence_scope_and_limit: Direct Lean 4.30-rc2 single-server 1/2/4 tiny file-worker guarded sweep, 25 exact-goal/diagnostic sentinels, 3 edits per cell, tree RSS/footprint, scratch bytes, latency and cleanup transcript. Boundary: 7.87-second tiny import graph; sampled summed RSS is not unique physical memory; no Mathlib-sized jobs, several servers, sustained leak result, full Anneal/MCP topology or cross-workspace conflicts.
v4_evidence_scope_and_limit: Direct pinned Lean server handled 24 edits, four close/reopens, restarts, wrong-import sentinel, rich info reference dereference/release and client timeout; sampled processes, RSS and footprint. Boundary: Tiny direct Lean 15-second run; no Anneal broker, Mathlib scale, hours-long leak inference, unique tree memory or proof of cancellation.
v5_evidence_scope_and_limit: Direct Lean three-minute guarded one/two/four-file-worker plus conflicting-import workspace ramp: 69 edit/goal checks, reopen/restart/session/reference controls, bidirectional request-ID collision pilot, RSS/footprint and latency samples. Boundary: One host and tiny imports, one watchdog at a time; no hours-long leak inference, unique tree memory, Anneal/MCP topology or full pipeline latency.
v10_evidence_scope_and_limit: Direct pinned Lean LSP pools with 1/2/4/8 concurrent imported tiny proof workers, serial cold local dependency builds versus warm prebuilt symlinks, open/edit/goal fanout, preflight 4.5 GiB admission, macOS per-process/group footprint/RSS samples, complete path/inode disk ledgers and owned worker cleanup. All 30 goal/edit cycles and clean shutdowns passed. Boundary: Two memory samples and one run per cell; no hard transient peak, sustained leak/CPU study, actual Anneal scratch service, MCP daemon, Mathlib-sized import or realistic CI capacity.
v11_evidence_scope_and_limit: One tiny imported direct Lean proof ran 336.55 seconds through three about-111.6-second server lifetimes, 63 versioned edit/goal queries, two orderly restarts and 36 periodic macOS group footprint/process-child/disk ledgers. After initial elaboration, sampled group footprint settled near 332–333 MiB and each owned tree exited cleanly. Boundary: Tiny 5.6-minute orderly-restart component soak with two-point-periodic sampling; no hours-long leak classification, hard transient peak, realistic imports, Anneal daemon or crash reconstruction.

section: O. Disk amplification, memory, throughput, and latency
title: Physical memory versus summed RSS
requested_scope: Measure platform-appropriate physical/proportional footprint and shared-page behavior alongside per-process RSS. Separate Lean workers, watchdogs, native plugins, and file cache. Establish a resource model suitable for scheduling; summing RSS must not be treated as unique physical memory consumption.
new_evidence_scope_and_limit: Guarded two-Lake-consumer cold/warm run and two-server four-edit sentinel, sampled RSS/phys_footprint/disk with clean shutdown. Boundary: Tiny fixtures, no Anneal generated project, Mathlib, high-worker sweep, long soak, PSS or peak-between-polls proof.
specific_remaining_delta: Measure unique physical process-tree memory or Linux PSS for representative workers/plugins; R16 sampled summed RSS and sequential per-PID phys_footprint, neither unique tree bytes.
v3_evidence_scope_and_limit: Direct Lean 4.30-rc2 single-server 1/2/4 tiny file-worker guarded sweep, 25 exact-goal/diagnostic sentinels, 3 edits per cell, tree RSS/footprint, scratch bytes, latency and cleanup transcript. Boundary: 7.87-second tiny import graph; sampled summed RSS is not unique physical memory; no Mathlib-sized jobs, several servers, sustained leak result, full Anneal/MCP topology or cross-workspace conflicts.
v4_evidence_scope_and_limit: Direct pinned Lean server handled 24 edits, four close/reopens, restarts, wrong-import sentinel, rich info reference dereference/release and client timeout; sampled processes, RSS and footprint. Boundary: Tiny direct Lean 15-second run; no Anneal broker, Mathlib scale, hours-long leak inference, unique tree memory or proof of cancellation.
v5_evidence_scope_and_limit: Direct Lean three-minute guarded one/two/four-file-worker plus conflicting-import workspace ramp: 69 edit/goal checks, reopen/restart/session/reference controls, bidirectional request-ID collision pilot, RSS/footprint and latency samples. Boundary: One host and tiny imports, one watchdog at a time; no hours-long leak inference, unique tree memory, Anneal/MCP topology or full pipeline latency.

title: End-to-end latency decomposition
requested_scope: Measure capture, projection, extraction, translation, import preparation, elaboration, and query response separately. Compare proof-only, Rust-model, import-header, and toolchain changes at several realistic sizes. Identify whether startup, serialization, generation churn, or actual proof work dominates before choosing an optimization.
new_evidence_scope_and_limit: Guarded two-Lake-consumer cold/warm run and two-server four-edit sentinel, sampled RSS/phys_footprint/disk with clean shutdown. Boundary: Tiny fixtures, no Anneal generated project, Mathlib, high-worker sweep, long soak, PSS or peak-between-polls proof.
specific_remaining_delta: Decompose complete Rust extraction, Aeneas, Lake, Lean and query latency under realistic edits; R16 measured direct warm Lean request medians only.
v3_evidence_scope_and_limit: Direct Lean 4.30-rc2 single-server 1/2/4 tiny file-worker guarded sweep, 25 exact-goal/diagnostic sentinels, 3 edits per cell, tree RSS/footprint, scratch bytes, latency and cleanup transcript. Boundary: 7.87-second tiny import graph; sampled summed RSS is not unique physical memory; no Mathlib-sized jobs, several servers, sustained leak result, full Anneal/MCP topology or cross-workspace conflicts.
v4_evidence_scope_and_limit: Direct pinned Lean server handled 24 edits, four close/reopens, restarts, wrong-import sentinel, rich info reference dereference/release and client timeout; sampled processes, RSS and footprint. Boundary: Tiny direct Lean 15-second run; no Anneal broker, Mathlib scale, hours-long leak inference, unique tree memory or proof of cancellation.
v5_evidence_scope_and_limit: Direct Lean three-minute guarded one/two/four-file-worker plus conflicting-import workspace ramp: 69 edit/goal checks, reopen/restart/session/reference controls, bidirectional request-ID collision pilot, RSS/footprint and latency samples. Boundary: One host and tiny imports, one watchdog at a time; no hours-long leak inference, unique tree memory, Anneal/MCP topology or full pipeline latency.

section: O. Disk amplification, memory, throughput, and latency
title: Sharing strategies without mutable aliasing
requested_scope: Compare direct read-only consumption, symlinks, hardlinks, reflinks, and copies on relevant filesystems. Attempt expected consumer writes in owned fixtures and inspect the producer. Measure disk savings and correctness together; copy-on-write appearance or identical paths do not establish isolation.
new_evidence_scope_and_limit: Guarded two-Lake-consumer cold/warm run and two-server four-edit sentinel, sampled RSS/phys_footprint/disk with clean shutdown. Boundary: Tiny fixtures, no Anneal generated project, Mathlib, high-worker sweep, long soak, PSS or peak-between-polls proof.
specific_remaining_delta: R40 demonstrated divergent APFS/overlayfs copy, reflink, hardlink and mutation accounting for a tiny file tree. title: Garbage collection with live readers
requested_scope: Retire generations while workers, pending queries, scratch forks, and replay records still reference them. Test imported memory maps and later file opens, not just open handles. Determine the safe reclamation condition and whether explicit leases, references, or isolated worker lifetimes provide it.

section: P. Retention, filesystems, portability, and execution isolation
title: Bounded retention across crashes
requested_scope: Interrupt cleanup and leave orphan workspaces, incomplete stages, expired RPC objects, and cancelled scratch files. Restart repeatedly and measure reclaimed versus retained space. section: P. Retention, filesystems, portability, and execution isolation
title: Rename, locking, and open-file semantics by platform
requested_scope: Repeat publication and cleanup probes on supported operating systems/filesystems; treat Windows or network filesystems as conditional until in scope. Include open mapped artifacts and antivirus/indexer interference where relevant. Do not generalize one platform's atomic rename or deletion behavior to another.
new_evidence_scope_and_limit: Two trials each on host APFS and cached Ubuntu/OrbStack Linux overlayfs: descriptor/rename/unlink/flock and 2,400 sampled reads per trial. Boundary: No mapped Lean artifacts, native Linux ext4/XFS, Windows/network filesystem, indexer or crash durability.
specific_remaining_delta: R40 compares host APFS with cached Ubuntu Docker overlayfs copy/clone/hardlink counters, supplementing prior open-file/rename probes. Native ext4/XFS, Windows/network filesystems, mapped live Lean artifacts and filesystem-specific Anneal worker cleanup remain untested; overlayfs exclusive physical extents were not measured.
latest_evidence_scope_and_limit: Real value-7/value-9 Lean OLean and plugin artifact bytes under host APFS aliases, replacement/unlink, resident/fresh Lean and open fd/mmap; cached Linux overlayfs byte lifetime replay. Boundary: Linux container has no Lean; no native ext4/XFS/Windows/network filesystem or Anneal identity routing and GC.
v11_evidence_scope_and_limit: One tiny 11-file/2.15-MB fixture compared APFS copy/clone/hardlink/mutation counters with cached Ubuntu 24.04 Docker overlayfs ordinary copy, successful reflink, hardlink and clone mutation. Per-file logical/st_blocks/inode, APFS volume-free, GNU du/df and Docker SizeRw counters diverged; base bytes stayed unchanged. Boundary: No exclusive overlayfs physical-extent byte accounting, native ext4/XFS/Windows/network target, large concurrent Lean jobs, cache GC or Anneal archive layout; Docker linux/amd64 is emulated on arm64.

section: Q. Acceptance, oracles, and adversarial test methodology
title: Real concurrency transcripts with causal barriers
requested_scope: Use controllable handshakes or instrumentation to place edits and rebuilds inside actual in-flight requests. Preserve ordering evidence and request/worker identities. Separate deterministic sequential demonstrations from genuine races, then repeat and minimize failures rather than relying only on nondeterministic sleeps.
new_evidence_scope_and_limit: Two direct Lean runs: exact imported artifact/fresh proof, weak/admitted/axiom/wrong-import/missing-claim controls, killed consumer, benign tactic IO and fake-token redaction. Boundary: Synthetic Lean proposition and local LSP only; no Anneal obligation graph, human trial or independent kernel.
specific_remaining_delta: R25 supplied sequential model identity cutoff; R26 supplied a two-process candidate barrier and one stale loser. Still exercise real Anneal request/worker IDs through in-flight cross-tool rebuild/editor interleavings and late completion.

Boundary: Independent CLI fixtures, launch-boundary stops for Aeneas/Lean, 80-ms delayed controls rather than phase barriers, no Anneal scheduler, escaped daemon or integrated pipeline.

title: Real parallel-test acceptance scenario
requested_scope: Run isolated generated projects against the actual shared read-only toolchain, with model edits, scratch trials, forced restarts, and cleanup. Combine the disk inventory and concurrency sweep. Define acceptable bounds from measurements and host budgets, not a promise of zero overhead or a fixed universal worker count.
new_evidence_scope_and_limit: Guarded two-Lake-consumer cold/warm run and two-server four-edit sentinel, sampled RSS/phys_footprint/disk with clean shutdown. Boundary: Tiny fixtures, no Anneal generated project, Mathlib, high-worker sweep, long soak, PSS or peak-between-polls proof.
specific_remaining_delta: R38 admitted four independent tiny Lean servers, isolated one malformed buffer, killed/restarted one peer and verified the other peers; eight was denied by admission. Actual parallel Anneal generated-project tests with shared imports, model edit, scratch publication, cancellation, restart and budget/fence enforcement remain unrun.
v3_evidence_scope_and_limit: Direct Lean 4.30-rc2 single-server 1/2/4 tiny file-worker guarded sweep, 25 exact-goal/diagnostic sentinels, 3 edits per cell, tree RSS/footprint, scratch bytes, latency and cleanup transcript. Boundary: 7.87-second tiny import graph; sampled summed RSS is not unique physical memory; no Mathlib-sized jobs, several servers, sustained leak result, full Anneal/MCP topology or cross-workspace conflicts.
v4_evidence_scope_and_limit: Direct pinned Lean server handled 24 edits, four close/reopens, restarts, wrong-import sentinel, rich info reference dereference/release and client timeout; sampled processes, RSS and footprint. Boundary: Tiny direct Lean 15-second run; no Anneal broker, Mathlib scale, hours-long leak inference, unique tree memory or proof of cancellation.
v11_evidence_scope_and_limit: Four independent pinned direct Lean LSP process groups opened tiny goals. One malformed unsaved buffer produced a local diagnostic while peers stayed clean; a second group's request was cancelled on the wire and its process group SIGKILLed, then a fresh server reopened saved proof while two peers remained responsive. Experiment-side epoch/version/hash model rejected an old candidate; eight-worker cell was denied by admission. Boundary: Cancellation delivery was not acknowledged/processed before kill; stale fencing was a model, not a late Lean reply or Anneal scheduler; no admitted eight-worker, shared-import or generated-project fault run.

title: Retention versus recomputation economics
requested_scope: Compare retaining source only; source plus projection; generated Lean; workspace-local Lake state; compiled generated modules; and live workers.
