requested_scope: Enumerate required inputs/artifacts/configuration for batch build, `lake env lean --json`, `lake serve`, per-file `setup-file`, InfoView/RPC, and native plugin/dynamic-library use. Classify producer-owned immutable state, consumer-owned mutable state, and any explicitly permitted shared-writable cache. Test the minimum source/control-plane material plus artifact cache as a reconstruction candidate and identify missing classes. Derive the identity under which pooling is valid rather than using a single unqualified “prepared” flag.

section: Scope extensions
title: Shared writable build-tree counterexample study
requested_scope: In owned disposable fixtures, compare consumers sharing one writable package directory or generated-module build directory with isolated consumers over a frozen producer. Run identical and conflicting builds and interrupt writers at controlled publication points. Check cache maps, partial outputs, subsequent reads/retries, and cross-consumer definitions. Seek the strongest valid shared-writer contract or preserve a minimal failure—not a preselected negative result. Keep artifact-cache publication distinct from shared package-directory mutation.
new_evidence_scope_and_limit: Tiny two-package Lean/TOML clean and relocated prepared Lake fixture, no-build checks, isolated home/denied loopback, native facet and cache wrong-object/truncated-map controls. Boundary: No real Anneal archive, server query, complete plugin/native family, network syscall trace, concurrent restore or full integrity oracle.
specific_remaining_delta: Force conflicting writers in a shared writable package tree and crash schedules with integrity/recovery oracles; R15 performed only one-command local replacement, and R10 private-root cache pairs remain distinct.
latest_evidence_scope_and_limit: Real Lake artifact-cache writer killed during paused Dep elaboration, two consumers with one killed writer, repaired no-build/ordinary build, truncated output-map rejection and retry. Boundary: Kill precedes cache publication; no crash at mapping rename or same-package concurrent writer proof.
v3_evidence_scope_and_limit: Pinned Lake 4.30-rc2 source and tiny cache execution: actual 64-byte output-map interruption and invalid-JSON rejection/repair; artifact insertion permission failure; post-publication truncated OLean false hit and Lean crash; missing-object repair; two private read-only-cache consumers and one shared-writable overlap. Boundary: Source review covers some listed configuration/cache rows without direct perturbation; no power-loss durability, all object types, conflicting shared writers, archive, Mathlib or Anneal server.
v4_evidence_scope_and_limit: Three two-process same-key Lake cache-miss pairs, then real RLIMIT_FSIZE partial OLean/ILean/C object writes, no-build false-hit, direct import oracle and explicit delete/rebuild repair. Boundary: Tiny private package roots and one pinned Lake on APFS; no causally forced simultaneous artifact syscall, power loss, shared writable build tree or Anneal last-good recovery.
v5_evidence_scope_and_limit: Six pinned Lake source/path/option/consumer-manifest variants and four valid local OLean/ILean/C/setup cross-generation replacements; no-build/setup, setup-import batch, direct local batch/server and two valid plugin initializer markers distinguished consumed bytes. title: MCP subscriptions versus polling
requested_scope: On explicitly supported protocol revisions, prototype subscriptions/change streams for generation changes, diagnostics, proof readiness, and verification completion; compare polling and explicit state reconciliation. Drop or delay notifications, disconnect clients, and retry result retrieval. Determine whether subscriptions improve responsiveness while polling/reconciliation remains the correctness path, and provide a capability fallback rather than presuming every MCP client supports the same mechanism.

section: Scope extensions
title: Server, MCP, and scratch-pool topology
requested_scope: For one prepared environment, compare N open proof files under one watchdog with N independent servers. Compare one MCP process serving many sessions, environments, or repositories with per-workspace adapters and an external broker. Sweep 1/2/4/8/... prewarmed scratch documents and compare fresh scratch creation, prefix reuse, teardown, memory, latency, and process ownership. Use conflicting definitions/options/plugins to detect cross-workspace reuse; do not pool independently configured projects merely because document APIs accept their URIs.
new_evidence_scope_and_limit: Guarded two-Lake-consumer cold/warm run and two-server four-edit sentinel, sampled RSS/phys_footprint/disk with clean shutdown. Boundary: Tiny fixtures, no Anneal generated project, Mathlib, high-worker sweep, long soak, PSS or peak-between-polls proof. | One direct Lean watchdog versus two on conflicting same-named Dep imports; direct session invalidation after close/reopen and summed RSS. Boundary: No MCP broker, Lake launch matrix, 4/8 document sweep, unique physical memory or delayed internal-worker response.
specific_remaining_delta: H08 routed two direct Lean servers; R48 drove one Lake-launched server after the actual tiny Rust→Charon→Aeneas chain, then fresh batch checked the same goal. Two-worker Lake/server admission was skipped; editor/MCP/product topology and realistic capacity remain.
v3_evidence_scope_and_limit: Direct Lean 4.30-rc2 single-server 1/2/4 tiny file-worker guarded sweep, 25 exact-goal/diagnostic sentinels, 3 edits per cell, tree RSS/footprint, scratch bytes, latency and cleanup transcript. Boundary: 7.87-second tiny import graph; sampled summed RSS is not unique physical memory; no Mathlib-sized jobs, several servers, sustained leak result, full Anneal/MCP topology or cross-workspace conflicts.
v4_evidence_scope_and_limit: Direct pinned Lean server handled 24 edits, four close/reopens, restarts, wrong-import sentinel, rich info reference dereference/release and client timeout; sampled processes, RSS and footprint. Boundary: Tiny direct Lean 15-second run; no Anneal broker, Mathlib scale, hours-long leak inference, unique tree memory or proof of cancellation.
v5_evidence_scope_and_limit: Direct Lean three-minute guarded one/two/four-file-worker plus conflicting-import workspace ramp: 69 edit/goal checks, reopen/restart/session/reference controls, bidirectional request-ID collision pilot, RSS/footprint and latency samples. Boundary: One host and tiny imports, one watchdog at a time; no hours-long leak inference, unique tree memory, Anneal/MCP topology or full pipeline latency.
v10_evidence_scope_and_limit: Direct pinned Lean LSP pools with 1/2/4/8 concurrent imported tiny proof workers, serial cold local dependency builds versus warm prebuilt symlinks, open/edit/goal fanout, preflight 4.5 GiB admission, macOS per-process/group footprint/RSS samples, complete path/inode disk ledgers and owned worker cleanup. All 30 goal/edit cycles and clean shutdowns passed. Boundary: Two memory samples and one run per cell; no hard transient peak, sustained leak/CPU study, actual Anneal scratch service, MCP daemon, Mathlib-sized import or realistic CI capacity.
v12_evidence_scope_and_limit: One tiny Rust→Charon→Aeneas→direct Lean→Lake build→Lake-launched server goal→fresh batch chain completed with selected proof/axiom oracle and sampled process resources. Boundary: Two-worker cell skipped by memory admission after one-worker 2,590,336-KiB sampled RSS peak; no Anneal scheduler, editor switch, hard physical peak or representative concurrent workload. | Two private real Lean servers, same-named imports, A→B→A router, unsaved A edit, warm return and cold disk reconstruction, PID/RSS cleanup. Boundary: Synthetic router; no editor extension, actual workspace-folder notification, Rust host, Lake/Anneal pool or broker.

section: Scope extensions
title: Fixture sharing and contamination sentinels
requested_scope: Compare one workspace per test, one per fixture with multiple phases, and one per logical suite. Give each test a unique model definition or option that makes accidental reuse observable; include conflicting plugins where supported. Run phases in different orders and parallel schedules, interrupt selected workers, then rerun subsequent tests. Measure disk/setup savings against required reset/isolation guarantees rather than replacing heavyweight sandboxes with untested shared mutable state.
new_evidence_scope_and_limit: Guarded two-Lake-consumer cold/warm run and two-server four-edit sentinel, sampled RSS/phys_footprint/disk with clean shutdown. Boundary: Tiny fixtures, no Anneal generated project, Mathlib, high-worker sweep, long soak, PSS or peak-between-polls proof.
specific_remaining_delta: Test per-test/per-fixture/per-suite contamination across plugins, ordering, restarts and imported models; R16 checked file-specific and wrong-import sentinels within tiny direct Lean workers.
v3_evidence_scope_and_limit: Direct Lean 4.30-rc2 single-server 1/2/4 tiny file-worker guarded sweep, 25 exact-goal/diagnostic sentinels, 3 edits per cell, tree RSS/footprint, scratch bytes, latency and cleanup transcript. Boundary: 7.87-second tiny import graph; sampled summed RSS is not unique physical memory; no Mathlib-sized jobs, several servers, sustained leak result, full Anneal/MCP topology or cross-workspace conflicts.
v4_evidence_scope_and_limit: Direct pinned Lean server handled 24 edits, four close/reopens, restarts, wrong-import sentinel, rich info reference dereference/release and client timeout; sampled processes, RSS and footprint. v5_evidence_scope_and_limit: Direct Lean three-minute guarded one/two/four-file-worker plus conflicting-import workspace ramp: 69 edit/goal checks, reopen/restart/session/reference controls, bidirectional request-ID collision pilot, RSS/footprint and latency samples. Boundary: One host and tiny imports, one watchdog at a time; no hours-long leak inference, unique tree memory, Anneal/MCP topology or full pipeline latency.

section: Scope extensions
title: Shadow files and hidden Lean-document lifecycle
requested_scope: If Lean/Lake requires physical paths, distinguish internal file-backed URIs from editor-facing logical documents. Independently of backing choice, open/change/save/rename/close a Rust host and trace hidden document creation, workers, updates, and cleanup. Keep unsaved source authoritative while deliberately stale or missing shadow files exist; crash/restart and reconstruct without treating mirrors as canonical. Test whether custom URIs require shadow paths, and whether model regeneration can preserve authored proof identity while changing the environment generation.
new_evidence_scope_and_limit: One direct Lean stdio connection plus two logical local clients: unsaved source, versioned goal/diagnostics, CAS retry, dropped local event/poll, restart/rename and direct cancellation. Boundary: No actual MCP transport, editor extension, separate clients, diagnostic multiplexing or real Anneal bridge.
specific_remaining_delta: Actual Rust editor host open/change/save/rename/close through Anneal projection and hidden Lean cleanup; new invented //% host in a local broker tests only lifecycle shape.

title: Batch and transport-free live shells over one engine
requested_scope: Build a small batch shell and an in-process repeated edit/query driver over the same structured engine. Compare the batch shell with current CLI behavior where implemented and the live driver with fresh checks on identical captured inputs. Include model changes, cancellation, and reconstruction before adding an LSP/MCP transport. Identify divergence caused by the engine separately from adapter protocol bugs; the prototype does not claim the current CLI already implements every stage.
new_evidence_scope_and_limit: One direct Lean stdio connection plus two logical local clients: unsaved source, versioned goal/diagnostics, CAS retry, dropped local event/poll, restart/rename and direct cancellation. Boundary: No actual MCP transport, editor extension, separate clients, diagnostic multiplexing or real Anneal bridge.
specific_remaining_delta: One actual Anneal engine driven by current batch CLI and repeated in-process live shell with cancellation/reconstruction and fresh exact-input oracle; current Python prototypes are separate.

title: Minimal interactive upgrade suite and workaround deletion probes
requested_scope: Derive a small retained replay suite for compatible toolchain tuples. For Lean/Lake, cover configuration ownership, workspace isolation, dependency refresh, goal versioning, server setup, and artifact families. For Charon, cover LLBC schema, span units, process lifecycle, determinism, and subject identity. For Aeneas, cover mutable globals, package layout, naming, provenance, determinism, and library/incremental APIs. Associate every manifest/trace/mtime/rewrite workaround with the exact behavior requiring it and a probe that would justify removal. Compare the examined 4.30 pin with 4.31 or another explicitly selected compatible candidate; retain accurate old-version findings and do not create a competing mutable corpus lifecycle.
new_evidence_scope_and_limit: Pinned one-shot Aeneas CLI input/flag/schema matrix, complete file/declaration manifest, stale output and partial-sorry failure. Boundary: No same-process library call, registered external-model mutation, authenticated cross-layer mapping or second release.
